# FunctionalBrainGraphEmbedding

**Domain**: Cross
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A low-dimensional representation of brain graphs that preserves geometric and topological properties, enabling efficient analysis and generation of functional connectivity. Enables compact and topology-aware encoding of complex networks, directly applicable to optimizing routing and resource allocation in TCC interconnects.
